severityPolicy.HARD FAIL: Security, authorization, data integrity, cleanup, build/deploy artifact, or critical journey only.
severityPolicy.STRONG WARNING: Release-quality or live-proof issue; normally resolve before release, but not a local security/data failure.
severityPolicy.WARNING: Documentation, governance, naming, noncritical drift, or maintenance issue.
severityPolicy.INFO / NO VALIDATION: Alias, orchestrator, report, manual lane, or metric with no independent pass claim.
